# Modern Coverage

> **Standard: 601 / 4702 (as of 2026-06-24)** — distinct Standard-legal card
> names (Scryfall `legal:standard`, `unique:cards`) covered by the authoritative
> `ImplementedCardNames.All` registry (reflection-backed: every `[CardName]`
> form — string-literal + const + fileless JSON — plus inline basic-land
> fallbacks; exact-name match plus DFC front-face match; name-keyed, so a card
> counts even when only reprinted into a Standard-legal set).

> **Headline (manual, 2026-05-28):** Raw 27.5% (6022 / 21917) ·
> Live mtgtop8 Modern top-20 most-played: 20 / 20. Sampled played-pool staple
> coverage ~51% (see Headline numbers note). Refresh the on-disk factory / template
> counts in the table below with `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh`
> (CI hook: `--check` exits non-zero on drift).
>
> The card pool itself ships embedded in `Majik.Core` as
> `CardData/Embedded/modern-cards.json.gz`. **Card factory PRs do NOT
> regenerate this file** — `IsImplemented` is derived at load time from
> the `[CardName]` registry (`Majik.Core/CardData/Factories/ImplementedCardNames.cs`),
> so adding a factory flips the flag automatically. Only regenerate the
> seed on a Scryfall data refresh (new cards / errata) via
> `dotnet run --project Majik.Console -- export-modern-cards <scryfall.json>`.

Pure helper `CountSharedSubtypeCreatures(Permanent)` enumerates the controller's battlefield creatures excluding the equipped creature itself (printed "other"), intersects their `Subtypes` with the equipped creature's `Subtypes` restricted to creature subtypes via an inline `IsCreatureSubtype` predicate (same carve-out shape as `OkoThiefOfCrownsFactory`'s Layer 4 type-replacement helper — excludes Land / Artifact / Enchantment / Planeswalker subtype ranges, treats every other enum value as a creature subtype). **Last updated (prior):** 2026-05-25 (`DamageIntent.IsCombatDamage` flag + Inquisitor's Flail damage-doubling retrofit. Engine change: `Majik.Core/Effects/DamageIntent.cs` grows a `bool IsCombatDamage { get; init; }` init-prop (default `false`) discriminating combat damage (CR 510.1) from every other damage-dealing path (spell resolution, activated / triggered abilities, ping effects). `Majik.Core/Combat/CombatFlow.cs` stamps `IsCombatDamage = true` on every intent it pumps through `ReplacementBus` — all three `DealDamageTo{Creature,Player,Planeswalker}` routes — so combat-damage-only replacements can gate cleanly without guessing from source / target shape. Non-combat construction sites (`DamageSpellFactory`, Soul-Scar Mage's existing rider, the `PreventNextN*` shield family) leave the flag at its default `false`. `InquisitorsFlailFactory` retrofit: PR #543 shipped Equip {2} + structural shape only with the damage-doubling clauses deferred. This PR closes the gap — `Create(Player, ReplacementBus?)` overload registers two new `DamageDoubleReplacement` instances against the supplied bus: (1) source-side ("if equipped creature would deal combat damage, it deals double that damage instead" — gates on `intent.Source == AttachedTo` AND `IsCombatDamage`) and (2) target-side ("if a source would deal combat damage to equipped creature, it deals double that damage instead" — gates on `intent.TargetCreature == AttachedTo` AND `IsCombatDamage`). Both replacements gate on the Flail being on the battlefield AND currently attached, so detach / blink / bounce auto-suspends doubling without explicit deregistration. **Last updated:** 2026-05-25 (Tutor / fetch routing through `ZoneService` — engine-wide ETB-trigger / replacement-effect fix. Closes the gap flagged in the prior Sakura-Tribe Scout + Explore + Amulet Titan engine audit: tutor-then-place-onto-battlefield factories (`PrimevalTitanFactory`, `ScapeshiftFactory`, `FetchLandCycleFactory`, `SearchSpellFactory.SearchLandToBattlefieldSpell` / `GreenSunsZenithSpell` — covering `SearchForTomorrowFactory`, every `[CardName]` fetchland, and any `SearchLandToBattlefield*Template`-bound spell) previously did raw `Zones.Library.RemoveCard` + `Zones.Battlefield.AddCard` mutation, bypassing `ZoneService.MoveCard`'s `CardMovedEvent` publication + `ReplacementBus` hook. Consequences pre-fix: bounce-land ETB self-bounce did NOT fire on Titan / Scapeshift / Fetchland-tutored Karoos; Amulet of Vigor's "Whenever a permanent enters tapped under your control, untap it" trigger did NOT fire on Titan-fetched tapped lands; ETB-tapped replacement effects on shock lands / bounce lands never applied to tutored arrivals — the printed Amulet Titan combo line only worked through cast-side land drops, never through the Titan's own fetch. Fix: new `Majik.Core/Services/ZoneServiceRegistry.cs` (parallel to `AgentRegistry` / `GameRandomRegistry` / `EventBusRegistry` — process-wide per-player lookup populated by `GameDriver` at game-start, cleared at test teardown) lets the tutor closure (built at card-construction time, executed at spell resolution) look up the live `ZoneService` without forcing a parameter-threading rewrite through `SpellDefinition.EffectFactory`. Retrofitted factories now consult `ZoneServiceRegistry.Get(caster)` — when a live service is registered the Library → Battlefield move routes through `ZoneService.MoveCard` so `CardMovedEvent` publishes + the `ReplacementBus` runs (CR 603.6a / CR 614). When nothing is registered (single-arg dispatcher / shape-test path) the closure falls back to raw zone mutation, so existing shape tests continue to pass unchanged. `PrimevalTitanFactory.MoveToBattlefieldTapped` taps the land AFTER the `ZoneService` move so the bounce-land / shock-land ETB-tapped replacement has already applied — double-tapping is a no-op (`Permanent.Tap` throws if already tapped; the new code guards `!perm.IsTapped` before tapping). Amulet of Vigor's untap trigger queues off the same `CardMovedEvent` because `ZoneService.MoveCard` calls `Permanent.Tap` BEFORE publishing the event, so the trigger's `IsTapped` predicate evaluates true at event-fire time (CR 614.6 — replacements fully resolve before triggers see the event). `ChordOfCallingFactory` / `GreenSunsZenithFactory` / `EldritchEvolutionFactory` / `UroTitanFactory` already had optional `ZoneService?` params on their `BuildSpellDefinition` entry points; updated to fall back to `ZoneServiceRegistry.Get(caster)` when the caller-supplied service is null — closes the cast-flow path where bots / `OracleSpellBinder` invoke `BuildSpellDefinition` without an explicit service ref. `GameDriver` deliberately does NOT call `ZoneServiceRegistry.SetDefault` (only per-player `Set(p, _zoneService)`) — keeps unrelated tests (which create a fresh `Player` and don't seed the registry) from inadvertently inheriting a stale `ZoneService` from a concurrently-running test collection. Tests: new `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/PrimevalTitanZoneServiceTests.cs` (4 tests — Primeval Titan tutors Simic Growth Chamber via `ZoneService` → bounce trigger queues on the live `TriggerManager`; Amulet of Vigor + Primeval Titan tutors Simic Growth Chamber → bounce-land ETB-tapped replacement applies + post-move tap is no-op + Amulet's untap trigger queues alongside the bounce trigger (CR 614 / CR 603.6a); direct `CardMovedEvent` observation verifies the tutor publishes one event with `FromZone=Library` + `ToZone=Battlefield`; no-registered-service fallback path produces the same end state via raw zone mutation so existing dispatcher / shape tests stay green). All 5748 Core + 304 Server + 149 Api + 135 Bot + 3 Bot.Integration tests pass. Coverage NamedFactory tier unchanged (engine retrofit, not new factories). Cards-db is being removed — pure engine work, no JSON / SQL paths touched. Unblocks Amulet Titan combo lines: Titan ETB → fetches Simic Growth Chamber tapped → Karoo's ETB self-bounce returns the originally-played land → Amulet of Vigor untaps Simic Growth Chamber → tapped-Karoo state cleared → bot evaluator sees the bounce-and-untap tempo correctly. Same fix sequence covers Scapeshift's "sacrifice N lands → fetch N lands" Karoo abuse and Search for Tomorrow's suspend / hardcast paths.)

Hand → battlefield routes through `ZoneService.MoveCard` when supplied so ETB triggers + replacements on the played land fire (CR 603.6a / CR 614) — the Amulet Titan engine bridge: bounce-land ETB self-bounce + Amulet of Vigor's tapped-ETB trigger both fire off the published `CardMovedEvent`. NOT a CR 305.2 land drop (CR 305.9 / 113.6c — "put onto the battlefield" bypasses per-turn / phase / stack gate); doesn't touch `LandDropTracker`. Introduces `CardSubtype.Snake` (creature subtype, CR 205.3m — Ohran Frostfang Snow Snake snapshot updated to surface the subtype). `ExploreFactory` (Worldwake / Modern Horizons 2 {1}{G} Sorcery) ships the card shape + `BuildResolveEffect(caster, landDropTracker?)`: (1) CR 305.2 bump — reads `LandDropTracker.MaxLandDropsThisTurn(caster)` and writes `current + 1` via `SetMaxLandDropsThisTurn` (audit conclusion: PR #447's tracker exposes only `Set` + `Max` reader — no additive `AddExtraLandDrop` method; Explore reads + writes; stack-safe + turn-safe via `LandDropTracker.ResetTurn`'s per-turn-change clear); (2) `Fx.DrawCards(caster, 1)` (empty library stamps CR 704.5b loss flag). Multi-Explore stacking is additive (each cast reads the post-prior cap). The two halves of the spell are independent — null tracker shape-path skips the bump but the draw still runs. **Amulet Titan engine audit findings**: (a) `AmuletOfVigorFactory`'s `CardMovedEvent` subscriber correctly fires on bounce lands fetched via `Sakura-Tribe Scout` / cast-from-hand because `ZoneService.MoveCard` applies the `ConditionalEntersTappedReplacement` (predicate always-false) before publishing the event, so `Permanent.IsTapped == true` when Amulet's trigger condition evaluates (CR 614.6 — replacements fully resolve before triggered abilities see the event). (b) **Known gap (not fixed here)**: `PrimevalTitanFactory.MoveToBattlefieldTapped` does manual `caster.Zones.Battlefield.AddCard(pick)` + `perm.Tap()` instead of routing through `ZoneService.MoveCard`. Consequences: (i) `CardMovedEvent` is NOT published, so Amulet of Vigor's tapped-ETB trigger does NOT fire on lands fetched by Primeval Titan — the printed Amulet Titan combo line "Titan ETBs → fetches Karoo, Amulet untaps Karoo" only works through the cast-side land-drop, not the Titan's own fetch; (ii) bounce land ETB self-bounce triggers also do NOT fire on Titan-fetched bounce lands. The end-state tapped flag is correct (Titan manually taps), so the bot's static evaluation isn't broken — but the dynamic combo lines that read `CardMovedEvent` won't surface. This is the established v1 pattern (Scapeshift / Search for Tomorrow share the same raw-zone-fetch shape) and migrating to `ZoneService`-routed fetches is documented as a separate engine-wide pass — flagged here so the next Amulet Titan polish PR can address the cycle holistically rather than piecemeal. New tests: `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/SakuraTribeScoutTests.cs` (7 tests — identity (1/1 Snake Scout), `NamedCardFactory` dispatch, activated-ability cost shape (one ICost + one effect), land-in-hand moves to battlefield, no-land clean no-op, mixed hand picks first land, `ZoneService`-routed move publishes `CardMovedEvent`) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/ExploreTests.cs` (7 tests — identity ({1}{G} Sorcery), `NamedCardFactory` dispatch, bumps max 1→2 + draws one, null tracker skips bump + still draws, two Explores stack additively (1→2→3), `ResetTurn` drops the bump, empty library stamps loss flag + bump still applies). Snapshot drift fix: `Majik.Core.Tests/Snapshots/snapshots/ohran-frostfang.json` updated to include `"Snake"` in subtypes now that the enum exists. All 5746 Core + 304 Server + 149 Api + 135 Bot + 3 Bot.Integration tests green. Coverage NamedFactory tier 370 → 372. Cards-db is being removed — pure factory work, no JSON / SQL paths touched. Amulet Titan engine unlock: Sakura-Tribe Scout completes the cast-side ramp loop (turn-1 Forest + Scout, turn-2 Amulet, turn-3 Karoo + Scout untaps it for {G}{G} + bounce + drop again); Explore is the cantrip ramp insurance pillar.)

Single 0..2 "target card in a graveyard" `TargetRequest` (CR 115.1b — "up to two" means `MinTargets=0`); resolution iterates picks (capped at 2), per-target legality recheck on `Zone == Graveyard` + non-null Owner (CR 608.2b illegal pick skipped per-target, other legal picks still resolve), moves each to its owner's `ZoneType.Exile`. **Scavenging Ooze audit**: factory's existing oracle interpretation is the printed-original "Exile target creature card from a graveyard. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter and gain 1 life" — wired end-to-end (cross-graveyard `allPlayersResolver` scan, deterministic first-creature pick, `CountersService` was not yet routed at write-time so the +1/+1 placement uses `card.Counters.Add` directly — same posture as Endurance pre-`CountersService` retrofit); the more recent "exile target CARD, then check if it was a creature" oracle variant is a deferred re-wording (no behaviour change for the dominant card-target case). New tests: `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/BojukaBogFactoryTests.cs` (8 tests — identity, dispatch, ETB-tapped wired vs shape-only, mana ability, target-player graveyard sweep, empty graveyard fizzle, controller fallback) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/FaerieMacabreFactoryTests.cs` (9 tests — identity, dispatch, Flash + Flying markers, `DiscardSelfCost` cost shape + `MinTargets=0` / `MaxTargets=2`, hand-zone gate via `DiscardSelfCost.CanPay`, two-target exile, no-target no-op, per-target illegal-on-resolution skip, single-target exile). All 5448+ Core tests + 341 Server tests + 149 Api tests + 135 Bot tests green. Coverage NamedFactory tier 301 → 303.)

**Latest origin/main:** Layer-4 type-strip primitive + Heliod devotion gate. New `Majik.Core/Effects/Layer4TypeStripEffect.cs` is a CR 205.2 / 613.1d Layer 4 (type-changing) continuous effect that conditionally strips `CardType.Creature` from a permanent while a controller-supplied `Func<bool>` predicate evaluates true. Source-anchored — `IsActive` gates on the source being on the battlefield, so the effect self-terminates on LTB; predicate is re-evaluated on every `ContinuousEffectsService.Compute` pass so live conditions (devotion, life totals, colour counts) drive the gate without re-registering. Layer-4-only — does NOT touch P/T / abilities / subtypes; stacks alongside other Layer 4 effects via timestamp + dependency sort (latest-timestamp wins per CR 613.7 when paired with a Layer 4 ADD-Creature effect like `KarnAnimateArtifactEffect` / `MutavaultFactory`'s animate). `HeliodSunCrownedFactory` gains a `(owner, triggers, effects)` overload that stamps the supplied `ContinuousEffectsService` onto `Card.ActiveEffects` and registers `Layer4TypeStripEffect(card, () => ComputeDevotionToWhite(controller) < 5)` (clears PR #506's deferred type-strip — Heliod now correctly becomes a non-creature while devotion < 5 and recovers Creature when devotion hits 5+ via cast/LTB without effect re-registration). Tests: `Layer4TypeStripTests` covers strip-while-true / lifts-when-false / live-predicate / scope-to-source / source-LTB termination / stacks-with-other-Layer-4 (AddSubtype additive, KarnAnimate timestamp-wins) / null-arg guards. `HeliodSunCrownedTests` gains four scenarios: devotion-4 strips Creature, ineligible as a Doom-Blade target (creature-only predicate fails), devotion bumps to 5 restores Creature, devotion drops below 5 strips again. On top of Storm-pillar audit + Past in Flames (Sorcery {3}{R}, Innistrad). Audit confirms `Majik.Core/Keywords/StormHelper.cs` is the single shared on-cast trigger helper used by `BrainFreezeFactory` + `TendrilsOfAgonyFactory` (Storm-keyword cards); both use it identically (capture-into-closure storm-count read at trigger-evaluation time from `TurnState.SpellsCastByPlayer - 1`, then N `SpellCopier.PushCopyOfTopSpell` invocations on resolution). CR 702.40a "you may choose new targets" + copies-as-distinct-stack-objects gaps remain as documented (inherited from `SpellCopier`). `Manamorphose` already shipped with `ManamorphoseFactory` (Instant {1}{R/G}, "Add two mana in any combination of colors. Draw a card.") — audit confirmed no new `IPlayerAgent.ChooseManaColorsAsync` hook exists; existing caller-supplied `Func<Player, ManaColor[]>` colour-picker + deterministic `{R}{G}` default is the correct posture. New `PastInFlamesFactory.Create` ships the sorcery shape; `BuildResolveEffect(controller, eventBus)` walks `controller.Zones.Graveyard.GetCards()`, filters via `HasType(CardType.Instant) || HasType(CardType.Sorcery)`, skips Past in Flames itself by name (its printed Flashback {4}{R} is the authoritative cost, not {3}{R}), and stamps `Card.GrantRuntimeFlashback` with each card's own `ManaCostValue` per CR 702.34. EOT cleanup via one-shot `StepStartedEvent`→`Cleanup` subscription clears every grant from the same resolution (CR 514.2 — same shape as `FlashbackFactory` + `SnapcasterMageFactory`). Printed Flashback {4}{R} on Past in Flames itself wired via `GetFlashbackAlternativeCost()` producing `FlashbackAlternativeCost(ManaCost.Parse("{4}{R}"))`. Bot-side discovery free via existing `RuntimeFlashbackAltCostProbe`. `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/PastInFlamesFactoryTests.cs` covers identity + dispatcher + grant-each-instant-sorcery + skips-creatures + skips-opponent-graveyard + skips-self + empty-graveyard no-op + EOT cleanup via bus + printed Flashback {4}{R} alt-cost. On top of Sorcery-speed activation gate (CR 117.1a / 307.5 — infrastructure PR). `ActivatedAbility` grows a `bool sorcerySpeed` ctor parameter + `IsSorcerySpeed` getter on `IActivatedAbility`; `ActivateAbilityAction` mirrors the cast-side `CastSpellAction.SorcerySpeedAvailable` pattern with a `(ability, player, sorcerySpeedAvailable)` overload (single-arg ctor defaults `SorcerySpeedAvailable: true` so the engine's hundreds of legacy activate-call sites are unaffected). `ActionValidator.ValidateActivateAbility` rejects sorcery-speed-only activations when the caller signals the window is closed, returning `RuleViolation("307.5", "activate-only-as-a-sorcery")`. `CardDefinitionFactory.BuildActivatedAbility` threads the JSON `sorcerySpeed` flag onto the runtime ability so JSON-defined cards (Walking Ballista's {4}: put counter) light up automatically. Nine named-factory retrofits flip the printed "Activate only as a sorcery" abilities through `sorcerySpeed: true`: `WishclawTalismanFactory`, `PriestOfFellRitesFactory`, `TasigurTheGoldenFangFactory`, `ColossusHammerFactory` / `SkullclampFactory` / `UmezawasJitteFactory` / `SwordOfFireAndIceFactory` / `SwordOfFeastAndFamineFactory` / `CoriSteelCutterFactory` (Equip {N}, CR 702.6a). `Majik.Core.Tests/Rules/SorcerySpeedActivationTests.cs` covers the four-timing-windows matrix on Walking Ballista plus instant-speed-rejection on Wishclaw and Tasigur, the instant-speed-ability-bypass path, and the backward-compat default. Mechanic-deps scanner: cluster #4 ("Activate only as a sorcery") moves from 9 blocked factories → 0 real (TirelessTracker false-positive remains). On top of Meltdown (Sorcery {X}{R} from Urza's Destiny — "Destroy each artifact with mana value X or less." `MeltdownFactory.Create` ships the sorcery shape; `BuildResolveEffect(caster, allPlayers, x)` returns a single `IEffect` that snapshots every supplied player's battlefield, filters via `OfType<Card>()` + `HasType(CardType.Artifact)` + `ManaCostValue.TotalValue ≤ x`, HashSet-dedupes via `ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance`, and routes each victim to its owner's graveyard via `OracleSpellBinder.MoveToGraveyard` (CR 701.7). Mirrors `WrathOfGodFactory.BuildResolveEffect`'s multi-player iteration shape with the Pernicious-Deed-style `mv ≤ X` predicate narrowed to Artifact only. X provenance: callers pass the resolved X directly (same simplification as Pernicious Deed / Engineered Explosives). Single-arg dispatcher path produces card shape only — no resolve effect, since X is unknown until cast. Indestructible bypass is the same lossy gap inherited from `OracleSpellBinder.MoveToGraveyard` — same as Slaughter Pact / Murderous Rider / Drown in the Loch / Embereth Shieldbreaker / Wrath of God) on top of Monastery Swiftspear (Creature — Human Monk {R} 1/2 from Khans of Tarkir + many reprints — Modern Burn / Izzet Prowess one-drop. `MonasterySwiftspearFactory.Create` ships the 1/2 Human Monk shape with the printed Haste `KeywordAbility` marker (CR 702.10 — same wiring as `EarthshakerKhenraFactory` / `GoblinChieftainFactory` / `GoblinRabblemasterFactory`) AND a Prowess `KeywordAbility` marker (CR 702.108) for shape-only keyword inspection alongside the prowess `TriggeredAbility` mechanic itself via the shared `ProwessFactory.Build(card, effects)` helper (sibling of `MonasteryMentorFactory`'s prowess wire-up — same `ContinuousEffectsService`-driven `ProwessPumpEffect`-on-Layer-7c posture). The `(owner, eventBus, triggers, effects)` overload registers the prowess trigger with the supplied `TriggerManager` so a controller-cast noncreature `SpellCastEvent` fires the prowess pump on Swiftspear (CR 702.108's "noncreature spell" predicate enforced by `ProwessFactory.Build`'s `EventTriggerCondition<SpellCastEvent>` — controller-match + `!HasType(CardType.Creature)`); `Creature.ActiveEffects` is wired to the supplied service so `Creature.Power` / `Creature.Toughness` reads flow through the layers compute. Single-arg dispatcher path attaches both keyword markers but does NOT wire the trigger (no `ContinuousEffectsService` available at dispatch — shape-only posture, same as `MonasteryMentorFactory` / `GoblinChieftainFactory`). ## Headline numbers

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Named factories | 2646 |
| Bespoke templates | 36 |
| Generic templates | 103 |
| JSON-defined cards | 1359 |
| Distinct implemented card names (`[CardName]`) | 822 |
| Estimated Modern played-staple coverage | ~50% |

(Coverage estimate, 2026-05-26: a sampled diff of the live mtgtop8 Modern
metagame — 273 unique non-basic cards across 15 decklists / 14 archetypes —
found ~51% covered by named factories + land cycles + JSON cards. This is a
**lower bound**: it excludes regex spell-template coverage, so some "missing"
simple spells actually resolve. Gaps cluster in recent Universes Beyond
crossovers (Final Fantasy / Marvel / LOTR / Avatar) and 2025–26 set lands.
Distinct names > factory classes because cycle factories — fetch / shock /
surveil / pain / check / filter / horizon / bounce / manland — each register
many `[CardName]`s from one class.)

### Template-covered (notable)

Cards implemented through generic or bespoke templates without a named factory. Selected highest-value Modern staples:

- Lightning Bolt — `Damage/DamageAnyTargetTemplate`
- Lava Spike — `Damage/DamagePlayerTemplate`
- Lava Dart — `Damage/DamageAnyTargetTemplate` (flashback handled by KeywordBinder)
- Skewer the Critics — `Damage/DamagePlayerTemplate`
- Mana Tithe — `Counter/CounterUnlessPayTemplate`
- Spell Pierce — `Counter/CounterUnlessPayTemplate` (regex broadened to recognize the "noncreature" type qualifier; pay rider consults the target spell's controller's mana pool)
- Counterspell — `Counter/CounterTargetSpellTemplate`
- Boros Charm — `Bespoke/StriveTemplate`-adjacent
- Boltwave — `Damage/DealsNDamageEachOpponentTemplate`
- Goblin Guide — vanilla keyword binding (Haste + reveal-trigger TBD)
- Eidolon of the Great Revel — triggered-ability binder (cheap-spell pattern)
- Monastery Swiftspear — Prowess keyword (`Keywords/ProwessFactory`)
- Fulminator Mage — `FulminatorMageFactory` (sacrifice-self → destroy nonbasic land, Wasteland-shape twin minus tap)
- Force of Vigor — `Destroy/DestroyUpToArtifactEnchantmentTemplate` + pitch cost
- Fatal Push — `Destroy/DestroyCreatureCmcLimitTemplate`
- Thoughtseize — `Bespoke/ThoughtseizePatternTemplate`
- Inquisition of Kozilek — `Bespoke/InquisitionOfKozilekPatternTemplate` (nonland + mv ≤ 3 cap; no life cost)
- Expressive Iteration — `Bespoke/ExpressiveIterationTemplate`
- Brainstorm — `Bespoke/BrainstormTemplate` (draw 3, put 2 from hand on top of library; v1 deterministic return order)
- Malevolent Rumble — `Bespoke/MalevolentRumblePatternTemplate` + `MalevolentRumbleFactory` (named-factory parallel: `Create(owner)` ships the Sorcery {1}{G} shape, `BuildResolveEffect(caster)` mirrors the template's reveal-4 / first-permanent-to-hand / rest-to-graveyard / `TokenFactory.CreateEldraziSpawn` body; `NamedCardFactory` dispatches the printed name to the factory so bot-deck loaders / shape-only fixtures bypass the Scryfall round-trip).
- Fetch lands cycle (10 of them) — `OracleLandActivatedAbilityBinder`
- Generic utility-land activated abilities — `CardData/LandActivatedAbilityBinder` (wired in `GameFacade.BindCardAbilities` after `OracleLandActivatedAbilityBinder`, before `ManlandBinder`). Lands are never routed through their `[CardName]` factory in prod (the factory instance-swap is gated on `!shell.HasType(Land)`), so these abilities were DEAD in real games; this binder makes them fire on the live table (v1-deferrals #12). Binds **26 utility lands** by verb family from oracle text: **scry** (Castle Vantress), **draw** (Sea Gate Wreckage / Castle Locthwain / Agna Qel'a / Bonders' Enclave / Memorial to Genius / Roadside Reliquary), **+1/+1 counter** (Gavony Township each-creature, Cave of Temptation target-creature), **token** (Castle Ardenvale 1/1 Human), **damage** (Ramunap Ruins each-opponent, Barbarian Ring any-target), **gain life** (Phyrexia's Core), **return from graveyard** (Buried Ruin), **return to hand** (Riptide Laboratory), **destroy target land** (Ghost Quarter / Field of Ruin / Tectonic Edge / Demolition Field / Encroaching Wastes), **Panorama search** (Bant/Esper/Grixis/Jund/Naya Panorama + Bountiful/Twisted Landscape). DEFERRED (need engine primitives): Channel family (Boseiju/Otawara/Takenuma/Eiganjo/Sokenzan — discard-from-hand activation), creature-land quoted granted abilities (Den of the Bugbear/Raging Ravine/Hive of the Eye Tyrant/Crawling Barrens), count-linked/attack-rider tokens (Treasure Vault/Dalkovan Encampment/Mirrex), Vault of the Archangel mass keyword grant, Desert combat-step timing. Tests: `Majik.Core.Api.Tests/LandActivatedAbilityBinderPipelineTests.cs`.
- Shock lands (Overgrown Tomb + cycle starts) — `Effects/ShockLandReplacement`
- Sacred Foundry, Steam Vents — shock-land binding
- Undying creatures (Young Wolf, Strangleroot Geist, Butcher Ghoul, Geralf's Messenger) — `Keywords/UndyingFactory`
- Ashiok, Dream Render — loyalty-ability binder (mill -1)
- Fable of the Mirror-Breaker — Saga chapter binder (partial)
- The Legend of Roku — Saga chapter binder (partial)

## Coverage by archetype

- **Burn** — Saturated. Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, Lava Dart, Skewer the Critics, Boros Charm, Eidolon of the Great Revel, Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear (`MonasterySwiftspearFactory` — 1/2 Human Monk {R} with Haste + Prowess `KeywordAbility` markers + prowess `TriggeredAbility` via the shared `ProwessFactory.Build` helper), Rift Bolt, Searing Blaze, Lightning Helix, Sunscorched Desert (`SunscorchedDesertFactory` — Land from HOU; unconditional ETB-tapped replacement via `EntersTappedReplacement` on the supplied `ReplacementBus` + ETB triggered ability dealing 1 damage to any target via `SearingBlazeFactory.DealDamageWithPlaneswalker` + `{T}: Add {C}`), Roiling Vortex (`RoilingVortexFactory` — {R} Enchantment with the upkeep 1-to-each-player + free-cast 3-to-the-caster + {1}{R}/sac 3-to-any-target activated + "players can't gain life" replacement; closes the Modern Burn sideboard hate slot against UWx control and lifegain decks) all in. ~100%.
- **Death's Shadow** — Mid-high. Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, Snapcaster Mage, Stubborn Denial, Death's Shadow itself (CDA P/T scaled by controller life — Layer 7a) all in. Mishra's Bauble in. Temur Battle Rage absent. ~60%.
- **Murktide / Izzet Tempo** — High. Murktide Regent done, Counterspell done, Snapcaster Mage done, Lightning Bolt done, Expressive Iteration done, Ledger Shredder done, Consider done, Spell Pierce done, Subtlety done. Monastery Swiftspear done (`MonasterySwiftspearFactory` — Modern Izzet Prowess one-drop, Haste + Prowess wiring via the shared `ProwessFactory.Build` helper). Sprite Dragon done (`SpriteDragonFactory` — Modern Izzet Prowess two-drop, Flying + cast-noncreature +1/+1 counter accumulator; same predicate shape as `ProwessFactory` but persistent counters instead of one-turn pump). Soul-Scar Mage done (Prowess 1-drop that converts noncombat damage from controller-owned sources to -1/-1 counters on opponent creatures — first `IReplacementEffect<DamageIntent>` in the engine; pairs with Swiftspear and Sprite Dragon as the Izzet Prowess cheap-creature trio). Cori-Steel Cutter done (`CoriSteelCutterFactory` — {1}{R} Equipment from Tarkir: Dragonstorm; static "+1/+1 + trample + haste" via paired `AttachedBoostEffect` registrations at Layers 7c / 6, Flurry — second-spell-each-turn trigger spawning a 1/1 white Monk token with prowess + auto-attaching; Equip {1}{R}). ## Top 20 Modern staples NOT yet implemented

Sorted roughly by build priority (small infra lift × high meta share). **Refreshed 2026-05-26** against a live mtgtop8 Modern metagame diff (273 unique cards / 14 archetypes). The prior "round 5" priority list shipped wholesale — its last survivor, **Simian Spirit Guide**, has since shipped (`SimianSpiritGuideFactory`, #1075). Cursecatcher, Silvergill Adept, Mantis Rider, Reflector Mage, Containment Priest, Meddling Mage, Skyclave Apparition, Leonin Arbiter, Temur Battle Rage, Boseiju, and the entire bounce-land cycle (Simic Growth Chamber et al.) all landed. The current gap is dominated by **recent Universes Beyond crossovers** (Final Fantasy / Marvel / LOTR / Avatar) and **2025–26 set lands** — the surveil-land cycle was completed in the PR that wrote this refresh (Commercial District, Hedge Maze, Lush Portico, Meticulous Archive, Raucous Theater, Shadowy Backstreet, Undercity Sewers), and the long-standing **Urza's Power Plant** dispatch bug (registered under the hyphenated subtype name, never matched the seed) was fixed so Tron can assemble.

Vintage / Legacy-only cards (Power Nine, original dual lands, Mind's Desire, Yawgmoth's Bargain, Library of Alexandria, Channel, Mox Pearl / Sapphire / Jet / Ruby / Emerald, Sneak Attack, Show and Tell, etc.) are deliberately excluded — this list tracks Modern-format staples only. (Dark Ritual, Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Lotus Petal, and Mana Crypt landed as named factories for Commander/historical-format coverage even though they're not Modern-legal.)

## How to update this doc

After merging a card-shipping PR:
1. Append the new card to the **Named factories** table (or **Template-covered (notable)** if it's a template port).
2. Remove it from **Top 20 not yet implemented** if it appears there.
3. Run `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh` to refresh the **Headline numbers** table from disk.
4. Bump the **Last updated** date at the top.

After merging a mechanic-infra PR:
1. Flip the relevant row in **Costs**, **Effects**, **Keywords**, or **Targeting / cast flow** to **Done (#PR)**.
2. If a top-20 entry's blocker is resolved, drop its difficulty one tier in the priority table.

### Multi-`[CardName]` for functional reprints

When two cards share an **identical resolve body** (e.g. Wrath of God +
Damnation — same sweep, different printed cost/colour), don't write two
factories. Stack multiple `[CardName]` attributes on the canonical factory
and expose a `public static <Card> Create(Player owner, string cardName)`
overload that branches on the requested name to produce the right printed
name + cost. The source generator
(`Majik.Core.SourceGen.NamedCardFactoryGenerator`) detects the second-arg
overload and dispatches each `[CardName]` through `Create(owner, name)`;
the plain `Create(owner)` overload stays as a convenience for callers
that don't care about the reprint variant. Headline factory-count drops
by one per collapsed wrapper — that's expected and the script handles it.

Don't apply this to **parametric cycles** (fetchlands, pact cycle, Mox
cycle) — those have per-card numeric or per-card-flavour differences and
stay as their own factories.

CI/pre-commit can call `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh --check` to fail when the headline counts drift from on-disk reality.

Keep this file terse. New cards = one row. New mechanics = one row. Long-form rationale lives in PR descriptions, not here.
